description: Creates a festive Christmas card (text plus SVG image) about someone, from their birth date and optional first name: sun sign and life path number, described as character, not prediction. The card text talks about the recipient in the third person (by name, or neutrally without a name). No personal data stored.

birth_date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 1988-03-14. Birth time and place are not needed.

recipient_name.description: Optional first name of the person the card is for. Letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only, max 40 characters. The card is written about this person in the third person. Leave empty for a card without a name.

name: create_christmas_star_card
